_doc: E01 assessment set — the acceptance-grade extension (issue #2151, 2026-11-24). Extends the #2148 campaign set (digest 8016d4a26a45…, 16 cases) to 67 cases: 40 anchor-scored retrieval cases (6 inherited + 34 graded), 14 restricted retrieval-class cases on the restricted_access surface, a 6-case outcome set and the unchanged seven security scenarios (every #2148 fixture exercised). The 16 inherited cases are byte-identical — the measurement instrument already signed against. The graded cases carry Phase-1 gold (preview + source_doc, no identity): every preview is verbatim committed-fixture text (enforced by tests/rag-benchmarks/test_assessment_grade_set.py — the #2145 no-invented-gold gate); the content hashes and the restricted source ids are venue-resolved products (the served chunk text carries the LLM doc-context prefix), resolved by the ingestion campaign's Phase-2 pass over the seeded corpus per the fixtures README protocol. Until that pass the anchor driver REFUSES this set's graded retrieval gold (no matchable identity) — by design: an unresolved set must not measure. The A reference is re-measured once on the final corpus+set and M-1 re-signed against that basis before any B/C verdict is composed (the #2151 acceptance's single re-baseline; the re-measure itself is the operator-driven campaign after this merge).
